findings.text: follow-on: _mounted_project_checkouts re-reads mounts.json to derive each mounted checkout as the docs path's parent, which reckon/mcp.py:3463 _list_projects already enumerates as {name, docs_path} through the same _mounts_path(); it also resolves the path through _mounts_path() while doctor's own mounts section at :905 reads _config_home()/mounts.json, so with RECKON_MOUNTS_PATH set the "MCP launches" and "mounts.json" sections of one reckon doctor run consult different files.

follow-on: the _LITERAL_HOME pattern matches a literal /home or /Users path only when it follows the start of an argument, whitespace or '=', so an argument that joins a home path with another separator such as "--project:/home/user/x" carries a literal user home the check does not flag.
